text_simplified: The text discusses the importance of choosing a righteous spouse for one’s daughter and warns against exposing girls to romantic and crime-related films, which negatively influence them. It highlights the necessity of raising daughters upon virtue and keeping them away from mixed and prohibited environments. It also emphasizes the mother’s role in guiding her daughter toward early marriage to a righteous man.
